title: Price Fairness and Strategic Obfuscation
authors: William J. Allender; Jūra Liaukonytė; Sherif Nasser; Timothy J. Richards
eligible_reason: Theory plus a lab experiment on price obfuscation and peer-induced fairness: cross-sectional OLS/logit of seller profits, obfuscation choice and buyer surplus on WTP measures by treatment arm (Tables 2-3) and a structural supply-demand model in GAUSS (Table 4). No staggered adoption and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: replication_code.do: reg totalprofit wtp_h wtp_l if treatment==k, cluster(sellersubjectid); logit avoidshowprice wtp_diff; reg surplus wtp_diff wtp by arm. MKS_SimulModel_Final.gss for Table 4.
software_notes: Stata; GAUSS 19 with MAXLIK for the structural model.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
